inventory.title: Agile sprint flow with agent input
inventory.summary: Sprint planning today is semi-manual: sprints[] live in state/<project>/index.json. Goal: agents PROPOSE sprint compositions based on plan ROI/effort/blockers/milestone; humans accept/override via the sprint.html Lock button. The proposal + acceptance flow is designed; first agent-generated sprint remains pending.
